schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE inventory (warehouse_id NUMBER, product_id NUMBER, qty_on_hand NUMBER, PRIMARY KEY (warehouse_id, product_id));
CREATE TABLE warehouses (warehouse_id NUMBER PRIMARY KEY, warehouse_name VARCHAR2(60));
original_sql:
SELECT i.qty_on_hand, w.warehouse_name
FROM inventory i, warehouses w
WHERE i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
  AND i.warehouse_id = 104
  AND i.product_id = 5148
gold_tuned_sql:
SELECT /*+ INDEX(i SYS_C_INDEX) */ i.qty_on_hand, w.warehouse_name
FROM inventory i, warehouses w
WHERE i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
  AND i.warehouse_id = :b1
  AND i.product_id = :b2
